item.title: Friday 1 PM Update, Oct 16
item.description:
The one o'clock update of Gumshoe News Radio for Friday, October 16, 2026, focused on what's new since noon: the Justice Department's suit against California over alleged noncitizen voter registrations, a White House order to throttle Ukraine's Starshield links, a midday market rotation out of A.I. and chips, Apple and Meta running a frontier model on Mac Studios, an OpenAI research model that spent someone else's test crypto, a cyberattack that has halted U.S. bankruptcy court notices, your X feed, weekend events in Londonderry, and a prairie bison herd that just topped a thousand. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
